title: Submarine crew showed the doctor the sonar room

tellings.quote: And so, you know, when I was on the submarine, uh, they took me into the sonar room.

plain: A doctor who worked with NASA, the US space agency, named Greg Rogers says that while he was aboard a US Navy submarine, the crew took him into the sonar room, where the boat listens for sounds under the water. He told this to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, as part of a longer account of what he says he saw during his career.
